header.title: How to Install a Wine Refrigerator
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to properly install a wine refrigerator, covering space measurement, electrical planning, and the final installation process.

steps.description: Verify the wine refrigerator's suitability for under-counter installation and check for back ventilation.
actions: Check manufacturer specifications for under-counter installation approval.
Inspect the wine refrigerator for back ventilation flow.
Locate the small vents on the underside of the wine fridge (front or back).
If back ventilation is present, identify the need for a front ventilation unit.
Source a front ventilation unit from refrigeration or electrical supply stores.

steps.description: Measure the intended space for the wine refrigerator and compare it to the refrigerator's dimensions, adjusting the space if necessary.
actions: Measure the length of the space
Measure the width of the space
Measure the height of the space
Measure the depth of the space
Compare measurements to the wine refrigerator's dimensions
Paint filler strips black (if needed)
Attach filler strips with nail gun (if needed)

steps.description: This step instructs you to plan the electrical source for your wine fridge, either by using an extension cord or installing a new outlet.
actions: Consider locating the wine fridge near the kitchen sink outlet.
Run an extension electrical cord to the outlet for the garbage disposal (if applicable).
Use a ground protector for safety.
Drill a small hole through the cabinets to fit the cord through.
Leave a small space at the back of the wine refrigerator to prevent pressure on the extension cord plug.
If necessary, wire a new 110 volt outlet (or 220 volt outlet for larger units).
Consult with an electrical contractor if wiring a new outlet.

steps.description: This step involves installing the wine refrigerator, plugging it in, checking the temperature, and ensuring it's level.
actions: Carefully fit the wine refrigerator into the space
Fit the mounting plates into the provided slots
Plug in the extension cord on both ends
Give the unit a few minutes to start the cooling process
Check the temperature gauge
Ensure the settings are about 55 degrees Fahrenheit at 70 percent humidity
Make sure the feet are evenly attached (if applicable)
Ensure the wine chiller sits completely level on the floor
